workload.name: EC2 storage options
workload.description: The hardware suite on EC2 instance types that differ only or mostly by storage: EBS gp3 at default and provisioned throughput, local NVMe instance store at several sizes, and tmpfs (RunsOn YOLO mode).

runners.label: runs-on={run_id},family=i7i.4xlarge,image=ubuntu24-full-x64,ssh=false,retry=false,env=demo
runners.note: 16 vCPU: part of the EC2 storage ladder only (how local NVMe scales with instance size); not raced against 2-12 vCPU runners.

suiteNotes.node: 8 GB is not enough for the opencode typecheck, even with turbo limited to 4 tasks: TypeScript processes are killed out of memory (exit 137). 16 GB passes.

suiteSkips.docker: Not run: the PostHog Docker build needs more than 8 GB of memory; it ran out of memory on 8 GB runners.

runners.note: 16 vCPU: part of the EC2 storage ladder only (how local NVMe scales with instance size); not raced against 2-12 vCPU runners.

suiteNotes.node: 8 GB is not enough for the opencode typecheck, even with turbo limited to 4 tasks: TypeScript processes are killed out of memory (exit 137). 16 GB passes.

runners.label: runs-on={run_id},family=m9g.xlarge,image=ubuntu24-full-arm64,ssh=false,retry=false,env=demo,extras=tmpfs
runners.note: Graviton on m9g.xlarge with /tmp, /home/runner and /var/lib/docker in memory (extras=tmpfs): the arm64 counterpart of the x64 tmpfs runners.

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 16 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner goes down mid-build.

runners.label: runs-on={run_id},family=m9g.2xlarge,image=ubuntu24-full-arm64,ssh=false,retry=false,env=demo,extras=tmpfs
runners.note: Graviton on m9g.2xlarge with /tmp, /home/runner and /var/lib/docker in memory (extras=tmpfs): the arm64 counterpart of the x64 tmpfs runners.

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 32 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner loses contact mid-build (out of memory).

suiteNotes.node: 8 GB is not enough for the opencode typecheck, even with turbo limited to 4 tasks: TypeScript processes are killed out of memory (exit 137). 16 GB passes.

suiteSkips.docker: Not run: the PostHog Docker build needs more than 8 GB of memory; it ran out of memory on 8 GB runners.

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 32 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner runs out of memory. r8a.2xlarge (64 GB) has the room.
